title: Meta signs six-year Google Cloud deal reported at more than $10B

sources.quote: WASHINGTON — Google has struck a six-year cloud computing deal with Meta Platforms worth more than $10 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Thursday, the search giant's second big agreement recently after one with OpenAI.
Meta has made a cloud computing deal with Google worth more than US$10 billion over the course of six years, a source close to the transaction told AFP Thursday.

explain: Meta agreed to rent servers, storage and networking from Google Cloud for six years, a deal sources put at more than $10 billion. It was Meta's first big cloud deal with Google; neither company published the terms.
